tweaks.name: Disable Game Mode Auto-Start
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from switching on Game Mode automatically.

tweaks.name: Disable Game DVR Capture
tweaks.description: Turns off background game recording and clip capture.

tweaks.name: Disable Fullscreen Optimizations (Global)
tweaks.description: Uses classic exclusive fullscreen behavior for all games.

tweaks.name: Disable Game Bar Startup Panel
tweaks.description: Hides the Game Bar tips and startup panel.

tweaks.name: Enable Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling
tweaks.description: Lets the GPU manage its own memory scheduling (needs a supported GPU and driver).

tweaks.name: Optimize Windowed Games (Flip Model + VRR)
tweaks.description: Enables windowed-game optimizations and variable refresh rate for windowed games.

tweaks.name: MMCSS Games Task: High GPU Priority
tweaks.description: Raises GPU priority for the Games multimedia task.

tweaks.name: MMCSS Games Task: Higher CPU Priority
tweaks.description: Raises CPU priority for the Games multimedia task.

tweaks.name: MMCSS Games Task: High Scheduling Category
tweaks.description: Sets the Games task scheduling category to High.

tweaks.name: Reduce Multimedia System Responsiveness Reserve
tweaks.description: Lowers the CPU share reserved for background multimedia tasks.

tweaks.name: Optimize Foreground Process Priority
tweaks.description: Gives the foreground app (your game) longer, higher-priority time slices.

tweaks.name: Disable Power Throttling
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from throttling background processes to save power.

tweaks.name: Disable Multiplane Overlay (MPO)
tweaks.description: Can fix flicker, stutter and black screens on some GPUs.

tweaks.name: Disable Fault Tolerant Heap
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from applying slower compatibility mitigations to crashing apps.

tweaks.name: Game Process Priority: High (per game)
tweaks.description: Runs a chosen game .exe at High CPU priority every launch.

tweaks.name: Force High-Performance GPU (per game)
tweaks.description: Assigns a chosen game to the high-performance GPU on hybrid-graphics laptops.
tweaks.note: param: fullpath of the game exe

tweaks.name: Disable Fullscreen Optimizations (per game)
tweaks.description: Turns off fullscreen optimizations for one game.
tweaks.note: param: fullpath of the game exe. // VERIFY flag string on your build

tweaks.name: Disable Mouse Acceleration
tweaks.description: Turns off Enhance Pointer Precision for 1:1 mouse movement.

tweaks.name: Faster Mouse Hover Response
tweaks.description: Reduces the delay before hover tooltips and previews.

tweaks.name: Fastest Keyboard Repeat Rate
tweaks.description: Shortest repeat delay and fastest repeat speed.

tweaks.name: Disable Sticky Keys Prompt
tweaks.description: Stops the Shift-x5 Sticky Keys popup in games.

tweaks.name: Disable Filter Keys Prompt
tweaks.description: Stops the hold-Shift Filter Keys popup.

tweaks.name: Disable Toggle Keys Prompt
tweaks.description: Stops the Num Lock hold Toggle Keys popup.

tweaks.name: Disable Touch Visual Feedback
tweaks.description: Removes touch and gesture visual effects.

tweaks.name: Disable Windows Ink Workspace
tweaks.description: Turns off the pen/ink workspace and its background activity.

tweaks.name: Disable USB Selective Suspend
tweaks.description: Keeps USB mice, keyboards and controllers fully powered.

tweaks.name: Disable Teredo Tunneling
tweaks.description: Turns off Teredo IPv6 tunneling (can affect some Xbox/multiplayer setups).

tweaks.name: Disable TCP Receive Segment Coalescing
tweaks.description: Disables RSC, which can add small delay.

tweaks.name: Disable TCP Auto-Tuning Heuristics
tweaks.description: Stops Windows from limiting the receive window automatically.

tweaks.name: Lower TCP Initial Retransmit Timeout
tweaks.description: Retries lost packets sooner (3000 ms to 2000 ms).

tweaks.name: Disable Nagle's Algorithm (All Adapters)
tweaks.description: Sends small packets immediately, which can lower game latency.

tweaks.name: Disable Network Throttling
tweaks.description: Removes the multimedia network throttling limit.

tweaks.name: Remove QoS Reserved Bandwidth
tweaks.description: Stops Windows reserving bandwidth for QoS.

tweaks.name: Increase Ephemeral Port Range
tweaks.description: Raises the maximum number of outgoing connection ports.

tweaks.name: Faster TCP Connection Cleanup
tweaks.description: Frees closed connections sooner (TIME_WAIT 30s).

tweaks.name: Prefer IPv4 over IPv6
tweaks.description: Prefers IPv4 when both are available (does not remove IPv6).

tweaks.name: Disable LLMNR
tweaks.description: Turns off Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution (less network chatter).

tweaks.name: Disable mDNS
tweaks.description: Turns off multicast DNS in Windows.

tweaks.name: Disable NetBIOS over TCP/IP
tweaks.description: Turns off legacy NetBIOS name service on all adapters.

tweaks.name: Disable Delivery Optimization (P2P Updates)
tweaks.description: Stops Windows uploading updates to other PCs.

tweaks.name: Disable Wi-Fi Auto-Connect to Suggested Hotspots
tweaks.description: Stops auto-joining open or suggested hotspots.

tweaks.description: Disables EEE power saving on the Ethernet adapter. Only applies if your driver exposes this setting.
tweaks.note: Driver-specific. Skip silently if the property is missing.

tweaks.name: Adapter: Green Ethernet Off
tweaks.description: Disables Green Ethernet power saving. Only applies if your driver exposes this setting.
tweaks.note: Driver-specific. Skip silently if the property is missing.

tweaks.name: Adapter: Gigabit Lite Off
tweaks.description: Disables Gigabit Lite power saving. Only applies if your driver exposes this setting.
tweaks.note: Driver-specific. Skip silently if the property is missing.

tweaks.name: Adapter: Interrupt Moderation Off
tweaks.description: Handles packets immediately; may raise CPU use. Only applies if your driver exposes this setting.
tweaks.note: Driver-specific. Skip silently if the property is missing.

tweaks.name: Adapter: Flow Control Off
tweaks.description: Turns off Ethernet flow control. Only applies if your driver exposes this setting.
tweaks.note: Driver-specific. Skip silently if the property is missing.

tweaks.name: Adapter: Large Send Offload v2 (IPv4) Off
tweaks.description: Disables LSOv2 for IPv4. Only applies if your driver exposes this setting.
tweaks.note: Driver-specific. Skip silently if the property is missing.

tweaks.name: Adapter: Large Send Offload v2 (IPv6) Off
tweaks.description: Disables LSOv2 for IPv6. Only applies if your driver exposes this setting.
tweaks.note: Driver-specific. Skip silently if the property is missing.

tweaks.name: Adapter: Wake on Magic Packet Off
tweaks.description: Stops the adapter waking the PC. Only applies if your driver exposes this setting.
tweaks.note: Driver-specific. Skip silently if the property is missing.

tweaks.name: Adapter: Wake on Pattern Match Off
tweaks.description: Stops pattern-based wake. Only applies if your driver exposes this setting.
tweaks.note: Driver-specific. Skip silently if the property is missing.

tweaks.name: Adapter: Shutdown Wake-On-Lan Off
tweaks.description: Disables Wake-on-LAN from shutdown. Only applies if your driver exposes this setting.
tweaks.note: Driver-specific. Skip silently if the property is missing.
